seasons.plot: Time has moved on in Season 2. Luke is now 13 years old and Ava is 10, serving up brand new parenting challenges for Paul and Ally. Luke’s increasing anxiety and Ava’s growing independence add some new and uncharted complications into the existing chaotic mix of stretched resources, lack of time and the fine art of winging it while looking like you know what you’re doing.

seasons.plot: Season 3 starts days after Season 2 ended. Paul has moved out and is staying at Leah’s house. He should be lonely, but the simpler life has its appeal. Eventually, though, amends with Luke must be made. Meanwhile, Ally has her own problems – with work, her early menopause and her increasingly strained relationship with her newly adolescent daughter, Ava. Gallows humor and large glasses of wine only go so far in quelling the angst…

translations.title: Breeders - Genitori al limite
translations.overview: La serie segue due genitori che lottano con la genitorialità ed è parzialmente basata sull'esperienza di Freeman come genitore. Freeman interpreta anche il ruolo principale nella serie.
Exposing the parental-paradox that it is possible, in the very same moment, to love your child to the horizon of the universe, while being apoplectically angry enough to want to send them there.

overview.value: In questa commedia onesta e intransigente, Paul e Ally si destreggiano tra carriere a tempo pieno, genitori anziani, un mutuo, dissesti nella loro relazione e le poco invidiabili mosse inaspettate del fare da genitori ai loro figli, Luke e Ava.

Il tempo è passato nella stagione 2. Luke ora ha 13 anni e Ava ne ha 10, aggiungendo nuove sfide genitoriali per Paul e Ally. La crescente ansia di Luke e l'incontenibile indipendenza di Ava aggiungono nuove e inesplorate complicazioni  al caotico mix della vita quotidiana.
